user.title: Set up DTMF Code
user.description: Select the Reolink SIP Gateway and configure the keypad behavior shared by all code profiles on that gateway. The next page creates one code profile with its own event entity.

code.title: Add code profile
code.description: Create one code and its own Home Assistant event entity. The numeric code must contain {min_length} to {max_length} digits. The number rule always refers to the remote counterpart: the caller on incoming calls and the called destination on outgoing calls. Numbers are matched exactly after formatting normalization; country-code formats are not inferred.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure keypad behavior
reconfigure.description: These settings apply to every code profile of this gateway.
